scientific_role: development-only exploratory performance-bound benchmark; never confirmation eligible and never a replacement for qualification-before-performance

forbidden: outcome-guided expansion or replacement of a hyperparameter grid
promotion of E1, E2, or E3 to confirmation eligibility
selection of a final development route during Task15G

common_design.preprocessing: pferi_v2_feature_preprocessing_contract_v1, refit inside every inner and outer training fold
common_design.inner_selection: frozen four-fold endpoint-component-disjoint assignment within each outer training set
common_design.training_weight: sqrt inverse first-order inclusion probability normalized to mean one within each training fold
common_design.validation_and_reporting_weight: full inverse first-order inclusion probability Hajek-normalized to mean one within each evaluated set
common_design.selection_score: mean of the four inner-fold design-weighted Brier scores, giving each fold equal weight
common_design.outer_prediction_rule: one finite honest out-of-fold probability per eligible model and development pair

E1.tie_break_order: smaller max_leaves, then smaller max_bins, then smaller learning_rate

E2.tie_break_order: smaller depth, then larger l2_leaf_reg, then smaller learning_rate

sample_weight_api_precheck.required_common_training_weight: sqrt inverse first-order inclusion probability normalized to mean one

E3.execution_rule: verify package version, checkpoint size and SHA256, and fit signature; emit no E3 prediction unless native sample_weight support is present in this exact frozen API
prohibited_workarounds: changing the package or checkpoint after observing E1 or E2 results
E3.scientific_interpretation: E3 is registered but not comparable under the common design because the frozen estimator cannot consume the required fitting weights

model_selection.unit: within each outer fold, select E1 and E2 separately using only frozen inner folds
model_selection.rule: choose the configuration with minimum mean inner-fold design-weighted Brier; apply the model-specific tie-break order only within the fixed tolerance
model_selection.refit: fit the selected configuration once on the complete outer-training set using fold-normalized square-root IPW
model_selection.failed_configuration: record the failure and continue only if at least one prespecified configuration remains valid for that model and outer fold
model_selection.failed_outer_fold: the model does not produce a Task15G performance-bound estimate; never omit, replace, or impute the fold

hard_failures: not exactly 445 unique development pairs or 116 endpoint-image components
fold assignment mismatch or endpoint-component leakage
global preprocessing before a fold split
class rebalancing or non-prespecified fitting-weight approximation
missing, duplicate, non-finite, or out-of-range eligible-model OOF probability

interpretation_rules.allowed: estimate how much development proper-score performance a tightly bounded nonlinear tabular learner can attain under the same information and validation design
interpretation_rules.not_allowed: select or promote E1, E2, or E3 as a confirmation model, introduce a new decision rule, or open calibration because an exploratory score is favorable
interpretation_rules.E3_missingness: structural non-executability under the common fitting-weight contract, not evidence of poor predictive performance
interpretation_rules.next_gate: Task15H qualification-before-performance freeze and validated development_model_freeze_record.json

runtime.target: ModelScope CPU or CUDA runtime with deterministic CPU fallback
